_comment: Lane definitions for arch-advisor. Override by copying this file to .arch-advisor/lanes.json in a project, to ~/.claude/arch-advisor/lanes.json for all projects, or by pointing $ARCH_ADVISOR_CONFIG at it. Each lane maps 1:1 to a shipped agent file: you can change a lane's model, effort rungs and timeout here without touching any agent, but adding a genuinely new lane also needs a new agents/*.md file, because Claude Code discovers agents statically at startup.

routine.route_when: The spec fully determines the outcome: mechanical edits, renames, wiring, boilerplate, tests that mirror an existing pattern, ordinary features with a design decision or two.

complex.route_when: Judgment the spec cannot capture decides the outcome: subtle concurrency, non-trivial algorithms, security-sensitive paths, gnarly debugging, wide-blast-radius refactors, or the routine lane already failed on a corrected spec.

alt.route_when: Third opinion, or the newest model. Race it against the routine lane on high-stakes work and let the architect pick the stronger diff.
